content.title: Chapter 62 - OFFENSES — Sec. 62-203. - Unauthorized control over a motor vehicle.
content.summary:
It shall be unlawful to obtain or exercise control over a motor vehicle without authorization
               from, or by threat to or deception of the registered owner or any authorized driver.
(Ord. No. 4006, § 2, 6-26-2006)
